He lifted the lantern higher, and for the first time in sixty years, he waved back.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合拢的书。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡黄色，清洁工推着小车，扫过昨夜留下的纸屑。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃缓缓上升。远处，一辆货车驶过桥面，声音很快沉入寂静。有人刚刚下班，有人已经出门，只有河边的树，还把最后一点夜色藏在叶间。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that holds a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no box inside."}
